fixes: Slack stays connected: it no longer stops working 12 hours after you connect it.
Google sign-in works in the agents' browser.
Brain always starts: if its earlier conversation can't be resumed, it starts fresh from its notes and tells you.
Codex with an API key or its own model provider now works for Brain.
mewla update restarts Mewla even when it runs in a terminal. A Mewla 0.4.9 or earlier in a terminal needs one Ctrl+C and mewla again first.

highlights.title: Diagrams and files, right in Chat
highlights.line: Flowcharts draw themselves, and every file an agent names opens with a tap.

highlights.title: Back in seconds after switching networks
highlights.line: Wi-Fi to mobile data and back: Mewla reconnects as soon as the network does.

highlights.title: Every update, told in Chat
highlights.line: A line in Brain's chat marks each update. Tap it to see what's new.

fixes: A Brain thread's chat opens on its own messages, at its end or where you were reading.
Windows: mewla update restarts a Mewla installed over SSH.
iPhone and iPad keyboards: Alt+b and Alt+f jump by word in the terminal.

highlights.title: Agent pages survive updates
highlights.line: Restart or update Mewla: the agent's browser keeps every page open.

fixes: A Worker still at work keeps its turn through restarts and long quiet steps.
Work stays open while its Worker still has a page open for you.
A full agent screen makes room for the next agent.
Mewla no longer needs tmux: every Session runs in Mewla's own session host.
On a Mac, Screen shows each agent's browser window live: hold it, type, or stop.

highlights.title: Answer agent questions in Chat
highlights.line: Sign-in, folder trust and first-run choices are cards you tap.

highlights.title: Updates finish by themselves
highlights.line: mewla update restarts Mewla onto the new version. Sessions keep running.

highlights.title: A Worker's page waits for you
highlights.line: A page a Worker opens, like a sign-in, stays in Screen under its name.

fixes: Windows: Brain runs on a Claude Code installed with npm.
When Brain, a Session or a Worker cannot start, Chat says why.
Claude Code or Codex installed for your login shell is found.
A new Claude Session in a folder you pick starts ready.
A message sent right after switching Brain arrives on its own.
Several people on one Windows computer each get their own Mewla.
Windows: a folder path over the length limit says so, and Up a folder works.
